description: The Rise of the Machines Level 58 Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic. Requirements: - Head of Argelmach - Intact Elemental Core x 10
name: The Rise of the Machines
